scope: ordinary UID1000 helper-authorized nusb/usbfs server over QEMU HID/FTDI devices to Linux VHCI; no host USB
qemu_version:
QEMU emulator version 6.2.0 (Debian 1:6.2+dfsg-2ubuntu6.31)
Copyright (c) 2003-2021 Fabrice Bellard and the QEMU Project developers
server_checks: RUSTUSB_PHYSICAL_OPEN_FD_DENIED: PASS uid=1001 route=open_physical json_refusal=true closed=true
client_checks: RUSTUSB_PHYSICAL_ATTACHED: PASS cycle=1 sessions=2 hid_driver=usbhid serial_driver=ftdi_sio
RUSTUSB_PHYSICAL_HID: PASS cycle=1 key_code=2 down=true up=true same_receipt=true
RUSTUSB_PHYSICAL_FTDI: PASS cycle=1 in=35 out=35 exact_bytes=true tty_echo=false same_receipt=true
RUSTUSB_PHYSICAL_ATTACHED: PASS cycle=2 sessions=2 hid_driver=usbhid serial_driver=ftdi_sio
RUSTUSB_PHYSICAL_HID: PASS cycle=2 key_code=3 down=true up=true same_receipt=true
RUSTUSB_PHYSICAL_FTDI: PASS cycle=2 in=35 out=35 exact_bytes=true tty_echo=false same_receipt=true
